verse.verse_1: When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake.
verse.verse_2: And when the earth throws out its burdens,
verse.verse_3: And man will say: "What is the matter with it?"
verse.verse_4: That Day it will declare its information (about all what happened over it of good or evil).
verse.verse_5: Because your Lord has inspired it.
verse.verse_6: That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds.
verse.verse_7: So whosoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant), shall see it.
verse.verse_8: And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant), shall see it.
